moment_method.label: Route A

obligations.what: truncate omega to omega_y at y = N^(1/2k); tail mean O_k(1) by the Mertens band, then Markov
k-fold double count: average of a product of prime indicators is floor(N/prod)/N
reindex k-tuples of primes by the set-partition of [k] they induce
per-partition estimate; blocks of size >= 2 each contribute ~lambda; leading term is the (k-1)!! perfect matchings
error term O(pi(y)^k / N) at y = N^(1/2k)
Gaussian moments: integral of x^k against gaussianReal 0 1 is (k-1)!! for even k, 0 for odd
method of moments: tightness, Prokhorov, Gaussian determinacy
alternative to A4: uniform moment bounds give charFun convergence directly, closed by Levy continuity
obligations.note: preferred; trades A4's determinacy theory for explicit-constant work inside A2

moment_method.hardest_step: A2b, reindexing k-tuples of primes by set-partition of the index set. At k=2 this is `rcases eq_or_ne p q` and costs nothing; uniform in k it has no Mathlib support and the widest error band of any obligation.

characteristic_function.label: Route B

obligations.why: requires iIndepFun and IdentDistrib; the prime indicators are dependent under the arithmetic measure, non-identically-distributed even under the independent model, and form a triangular array rather than a sequence

obligations.verdict: absent from Mathlib, and heavier than the route needs (it supplies a rate; Erdos-Kac needs only the limit)

obligations.what: CLT for a triangular array of independent, non-identically-distributed, uniformly bounded summands
transfer from the arithmetic measure to the independent Bernoulli model
obligations.why: needs the fundamental lemma of sieve theory (Kubilius), which Mathlib does not have (its sieve is upper-bound only) and which has no Lean formalization. The sieve-free variant fails: naive Mobius inclusion-exclusion over y-smooth squarefree divisors has error 2^(pi(y)), forcing y about log N, at which point loglog y is not asymptotic to loglog N and the normalisation dies.

characteristic_function.hardest_step: B4. Not a large amount of known Lean work but a piece of mathematics nobody has formalized, whose cost is not estimable from here.

structural_finding.statement: Route A needs only k-fold products, so its accumulated arithmetic error is pi(y)^k, polynomial. Route B's characteristic function needs all orders at once, so its error is 2^(pi(y)), exponential. Polynomial error tolerates y = N^(1/2k), which keeps loglog y asymptotic to loglog N; exponential error does not.
structural_finding.consequence: the two routes are not two prices for the same object; one is priced and the other is blocked
structural_finding.grade: derived in this run, not taken from a source; elementary, and flagged as a loose thread

correction_to_prior_prose.claim: the Mertens band 16 does not need tightening for Erdos-Kac
correction_to_prior_prose.why: the moment route uses the band only as an O(1) shift from lambda to loglog N, divided by sqrt(loglog N). Mertens with its constant M is not required and this tree does not have it.
correction_to_prior_prose.supersedes: hunts/r_0339c1/RESULTS.md treats the band as the lever; true for the Hardy-Ramanujan constant 275, not for Erdos-Kac

recommendation.first_obligation: the k=4 central moment of omega_y with truncation: sum over n<=N of (omega_y(n) - lambda)^4 / N = 3*lambda^2 + O(lambda^1.5), as a single bounded file
recommendation.why_k4: smallest case where A2b is real: it has a 3-block-plus-singleton partition and two distinct perfect matchings, so the (k-1)!! count is exercised. k=3 is degenerate (leading term vanishes).
recommendation.stop_condition: if the k=4 file exceeds roughly 600 lines, more than twice the k=2 moment computation, the general-k estimate has failed and general k is out of reach at this tree's current state
cheap_alternatives_independent_of_erdos_: B3, the triangular-array CLT: the most reusable object either route touches, wanted upstream, bounded
A3, the Gaussian moments: bounded, standard, absent from Mathlib
A4, method of moments: a Mathlib-grade contribution in its own right
the normal order of ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (Omega): ~150 lines, best lines-to-result ratio in sight, on neither route
